attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation (Veterinary Licensing and Disciplinary Board)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs given by approved veterinary or CVT programs, AVMA CVTEA, ISVMA or other state/provincial VMAs, AAHA, AAVSB RACE, veterinary specialty organizations, USDA; self-study from approved providers allowed
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for the first renewal after the certificate is issued.
rules.alternatives: Waiver for good cause; CE used for another state may count.
rules.audit_note: Division may require evidence; keep CE records 4 years.
rules.notes: Prerenewal period = 24 months before certificate expiration. Sexual harassment prevention training required before each renewal (20 ILCS 2105/2105-15.5).
